title: Unit Event — What Lies Beyond Guiding a Lost Child — Episode6 Fun-Filled Commotion

meta.Event: What Lies Beyond Guiding a Lost Child
meta.Event Outline: With university practice exams looming, Mafuyu continues to study to meet her mother's expectations. Meanwhile, Mizuki suggests a trip to an amusement park for N25.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
So many people.
I don't remember having to do so much maneuvering the last time I was here.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You can probably thank the night show for going viral online. They've been traveling to do shows as ambassadors too, so more people from further away have apparently been visiting the park.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I see...
You seem to know a lot about this, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Well, I'm friends with someone from the cast. He even directed the original night show, so I kinda want all of us to see it if we have the time...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(What's Mom going to say...
After supporting me so much too.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Maybe if I go back now, I can still...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sorry, Miku, you guys gotta hide!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I-Is everything okay?
You seem even less cheerful than you usually... No, wait! I mean, something seems different...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, it's okay. I'm just fine...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But what are the odds of us meeting here like this? Are you here to enjoy the park as well?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm actually about to do a show!
I'm one of the cast members here!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right...
I'm sorry. I remember you mentioning that now.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
No, that's fine!
Are you here with your friends today, Asahina?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
You're a cast member...?
Does that mean you're gonna be in the night show?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yes!
We'll be doing a show at the Wonder Stage before the night show too, so please come and watch if you can!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Thanks! We were just talking about seeing it!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe...!
I'll do my best to make you all feel really wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Asahina...!
I hope you enjoy your visit to Phoenix Wonderland!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Because this is a place that makes everyone smile!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Bye bye! Good luck during the show!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: A place that makes everyone smile...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Is she one of your juniors from school, Mafuyu? She seems really cheerful.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <But she seemed really scared of you, Mafuyu.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Even though you're really not scary at all...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, she was plenty scary just now.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But you couldn't really help it. Especially today. Anyway, we're here to relax and have fun, so try not to push yourself too hard, okay?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Are you sure you're okay, Mafuyu?
If you don't feel well, we can take a little break...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I'm okay, really.
I'll even go on whatever rides you want.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Really?!
I had something in mind just in case you said that! Let's go, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, they're a park's attractions, and it's fun to go on them as a group.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And the one I wanna go on is... The Phoenix Coaster!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Isn't that a pretty intense roller coaster? Are you sure you don't wanna choose something more kid-friendly since Len and the others are with us?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You say that... But you're really the one that's scared, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Nah, I'm sure you'll be fine...
But it might be safer to try something more kid-friendly before going on the faster one!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Speaking of which, Mafuyu, have you ever been here before?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, it's just... I can't see the current you visiting Phoenix Wonderland is all...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I came here once with my mom when I was little...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (What was it like when I came here with her...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Here we are!
Alright, let's give it a go!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whew! That was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<I had fun too...!
Whizzing around on those rides was so amazing.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I agree. I was a bit startled, but we also got to see some beautiful sights.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm glad you guys liked it, but I could really go for a quick break now...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm going to get something to drink...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I ended up staying this long...
There's no point in going now...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I don't know...
I don't even understand why I came here.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Honestly, why did I come here...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Would you rather be taking that practice exam instead of being here with everyone else...?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I know that the practice exam is more important and that Mom wanted me to do well on it...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Mafuyu, I'm not seeing Kanade or the others.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Which direction did I come from...?
